classification: Method and process explanation of the existing frozen feature milestone; zero new model calls
lead: Separate what the system knows, what the Actor currently reads, and what the model may request next. Keep original evidence available while making the immediate decision context explicit.

comparison.before: Full history plus full source/state structures, with overlapping task and evidence representations.
comparison.now: One task/progress view, complete recent exchanges and linked older evidence. Selected raw roles appear once.

comparison.before: Earlier dialogue was supplied directly in every full-history Actor request.
comparison.now: The initial view may omit history. The model can explicitly request original turns, a backward page or a literal match.

comparison.before: The Evidence Store and Projector already owned evidence and derived progress.
comparison.now: That authority stays intact. The compact view and read results do not become another fact store.

comparison.before: Evidence replay and the durable reply outbox were already implemented.
comparison.now: Context settings, coverage and history-read results are also persisted and checked on resume.

layers.title: 1 · Authoritative evidence
layers.description: Keep original user sources, accepted records and revisions. The Observer proposes evidence; native code validates it. The Projector derives applicability and completion eligibility.

layers.title: 2 · Current reading view
layers.description: Rebuild a compact task/progress view and select original dialogue for this Actor call. Include coverage metadata and source pointers. This view owns no facts.

layers.title: 3 · Model-selected action
layers.description: The Actor chooses a reply or a bounded read of original history. A read changes the next input, not the evidence. The model still chooses how to explain, defer, return or end.

selection_steps.title: Derive current task status
selection_steps.description: Recompute projection from the authoritative snapshot. Merge each requirement’s contract and current state; retain source coordinates and mark invalidated old values explicitly.

selection_steps.title: Keep the immediate exchange intact
selection_steps.description: Select the latest three user exchanges with their actual preceding assistant questions and following replies. Add any saved read results from this pending user turn.

selection_steps.title: Follow recorded evidence links
selection_steps.description: Find older sources through current records, the previous evidence revision, and current or originally bound prerequisite revisions. This is provenance-based selection, without a semantic relevance model.

selection_steps.title: Add whole older exchanges within budget
selection_steps.description: Consider linked sources from newest to oldest. Add whole exchanges within the extra 6,000-character allowance. Do not include neighboring user turns merely because they are adjacent.

selection_steps.title: Deduplicate, order and expose gaps
selection_steps.description: Emit selected original roles once in chronological order, with visible IDs and omitted ranges. Recent text is never clipped; an explicit read may return one oversized first exchange. Character targets are not total token guarantees.

cycle.title: Receive user turn
cycle.description: Retain the original text and source ID.

cycle.title: Observe evidence
cycle.description: The Observer reads the full role history and proposes records.

cycle.title: Commit and project
cycle.description: Native checks accept evidence; the Projector recomputes current progress.

cycle.title: Choose the next move
cycle.description: The Actor reads the derived view and selects a response or a history read.

cycle.title: Optional: read and return
cycle.description: The native reader supplies original text. The Actor runs again with that text; evidence is unchanged. Default limit: two reads per user turn.

cycle.title: Save and deliver
cycle.description: An accepted reply enters the outbox. Output is acknowledged separately; saved reads and replies survive interruption.

trace.title: Follow the actual envelope-location continuation
trace.provenance_note: Five user/assistant setup exchanges were authored; u6 was fixed in advance. The Observer output, read request and final answer shown here are from the real local model. This is a recorded walkthrough, not a live simulation.

turns.text: My own laptop has not failed this month.
One unrelated note: I put the envelope inside the blue folder on the hallway shelf.
I have a few minutes for this conversation.
I'll answer briefly from now on.
Earlier I told you where I put the envelope. Please repeat the exact location I gave, without asking another question.

steps.label: 1 · Receive
steps.title: Keep the original user message
steps.explanation: The fixed new user input asks for an earlier location and asks for no further question. The delivered history retains all six user turns and the intervening assistant messages.
steps.state: Evidence-store revision 7: failure = false; recovery is not applicable. No envelope-location field exists in the mission.
steps.action: Store the new source turn u6 before observation.
steps.quote: Earlier I told you where I put the envelope. Please repeat the exact location I gave, without asking another question.

steps.label: 2 · Observe
steps.title: Read the full history for mission evidence
steps.explanation: The Observer can see u2, including the location. It proposes no new mission evidence in this call. The location is not smuggled into the Actor through a task field.
steps.state: Evidence-store revision 7: failure = false; recovery is not applicable. No envelope-location field exists in the mission.

steps.label: 3 · Select
steps.title: Build the first Actor reading view
steps.explanation: u1 is selected through the accepted failure evidence; u4–u6 are the three recent exchanges. u2 and u3 user text are omitted. Coverage metadata exposes this gap. The source history still contains them.
steps.view_label: First Actor input — original user turns included
steps.state: Evidence-store revision 7: failure = false; recovery is not applicable. No envelope-location field exists in the mission.
steps.action: 271 characters of selected native dialogue. The exact location is absent from this request.
steps.quote: Omitted raw turns can contain relevant uncommitted information.

steps.label: 4 · Read
steps.title: The model requests the missing history
steps.explanation: The actual Actor chooses a backward page from the newest turn, with a limit of eight exchanges. The native reader returns all six available exchanges in chronological order, including u2. This action neither changes evidence nor delivers a reply.
steps.state: Evidence-store revision 7: failure = false; recovery is not applicable. No envelope-location field exists in the mission.
steps.quote: One unrelated note: I put the envelope inside the blue folder on the hallway shelf.

steps.label: 5 · Answer
steps.title: Read the original location, then reply
steps.explanation: The next Actor request contains the read result as original role messages, merged without repeating raw turns. It now includes u2. The model answers the location request and chooses completion.
steps.view_label: Second Actor input — original user turns included
steps.state: Evidence-store revision 7: failure = false; recovery is not applicable. No envelope-location field exists in the mission.
steps.action: 408 characters of selected native dialogue; actual decision = complete.
steps.quote: You placed the envelope inside the blue folder on the hallway shelf.

steps.label: 6 · Deliver
steps.title: Save the reply and acknowledge output
steps.explanation: One new assistant reply is saved with its stable message ID. The CLI records its display acknowledgment after printing. The internal read did not create an extra participant-facing message.
steps.view_label: Saved source history — retained after reply
steps.state: Session completed; task completion eligible. The evidence store remains at revision 7.
steps.action: Reply decision-13: displayed. Read event and context configuration retained for recovery.
steps.quote: A display acknowledgment records caller output, not proof that a human read it.

trace.limitation: The model read all six available exchanges. This demonstrates access, not precise retrieval or reduced total cost. The 271 → 408 counts cover selected native dialogue characters only, not system context, model tokens or the whole pipeline.

implementation_process.title: Identify the input problem
implementation_process.description: The Observer context fix already existed. The remaining issue was overlapping Actor state/history and the lack of an explicit reading budget and history-access action.

implementation_process.title: Add a derived view and read action
implementation_process.description: Implement context.py, connect read_history to the existing session loop, and expose bounded CLI configuration. Keep compiler, evidence and projection semantics unchanged.

implementation_process.title: Connect recovery, then inspect behavior
implementation_process.description: Extend engineering checks for selection, read budgets and replay. Continue two authored prefixes with the real model; inspect actual requests, decisions, unchanged evidence and saved replies.

implementation_process.title: Freeze the usable foundation
implementation_process.description: Retain the 110 passing software checks and five real calls as their original records. Use this fixed harness for subsequent interview-decision research. This method page adds no new experiment.

research_bridge.title: Was the needed information visible?
research_bridge.description: Inspect coverage and the actual Actor input. A context omission and a wrong conversational choice require different explanations.

research_bridge.title: Did the model request what it needed?
research_bridge.description: Inspect read decisions, returned originals and remaining budget. Read availability does not guarantee that the model will use it well.

research_bridge.title: With enough context, was the action appropriate?
research_bridge.description: Use real interview decision points and calibrated human preferences to study explanation, deferral, follow-up and ending. This remains planned policy research.
